basic_info.description: Discover this fantastic opportunity to personalize a cherished family home, gracing the market for the very first time. This well-cared-for residence has been lovingly maintained for many years and is ready for its next chapter. Boasting over 1,700 sqft, this home features 4BR/3BA, 2-car tandem garage, complemented by a versatile separate multi-purpose room (could be a studio, 4th bedroom/full bath, gym, or home office. Enjoy breathtaking city & downtown views from 2 walk-out decks. The main living level presents a large, cozy living room, a formal dining area & a functional kitchen. This level also hosts a primary suite, 2 additional bedrooms & a full bathroom, all conveniently located on the same floor. The street level provides parking, a bonus room & an additional bath. The primary suite features a step out deck, 2 closets, dual sink vanity & updated bathroom. Tons of storage at the lower level. Step outside to a generously sized yard, offering outdoor potential. The home's prime location provides easy access to freeways, BART & public transit, making commuting a breeze. Enjoy proximity to local restaurants, shops, groceries & amenities. Just minutes away from McLaren Park, Mission Street's vibrant scene, Bernal Heights' charming eateries & the lively Glen Park neighborhood.
